drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 46-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.78, creatinine 0.85, hemoglobin 14.8, pao2 55, platelets 306, sodium 139, wbc 7.9; vitals dbp 73-78, heart_rate 72-76, map 89-93, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 28-32, sbp 118-124, spo2 88-93, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.86, hemoglobin 14.7, platelets 302, sodium 139, wbc 7.9; vitals dbp 73-77, heart_rate 74-77, map 89-92, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 20-26, sbp 119-123, spo2 93-94, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 46-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
